p.scope-of-this-document: **Scope of this document.** Four designs that look reasonable and are wrong, each with its full reasoning, plus the exact hard-stop drill the tool runs when it meets a malformed block.

p.catalogue-the-temptations-once: These are the shortcuts every author of a file-writing tool is tempted by; catalogue them once so the temptation is answered before it costs a user's data.

sidecar.title: A sidecar file instead of a block

p.SIDECAR-DESIGN-DO-NOT-TOUCH-THE-HOST-FIL: *The design.* Do not touch the host file at all.

p.SIDECAR-DESIGN-WRITE-INTO-A-COMPANION-FI: Write the tool's content into a companion file next to it — `.tool/redirect`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.toolrc` — and point the real consumer at the sidecar.

p.sidecar-why-the-host-files-value-is-zero: *Why it is rejected.* The entire value of a host file like `CLAUDE.md`, `~/.bashrc`, or `ssh_config` is that its consumer **already reads it, with zero configuration**.

p.sidecar-that-is-the-property-you-are-buy: That is the property you are buying by writing there.

p.SIDECAR-FORFEITS-THE-ZERO-CONFIGURATION-: A sidecar the consumer does not natively read forfeits exactly that property: now something must be taught to read the sidecar, and that teaching step is one more thing to install, get wrong, and drift.

p.sidecar-users-read-the-host-file: Users read the host file — it is where they look for what is in effect.

p.sidecar-content-exiled-is-content-nobody: Content exiled to a sidecar is content nobody sees until it misbehaves.

p.SIDECAR-TRADES-A-SOLVED-PROBLEM-FOR-AN-U: The sidecar trades a solved problem (write politely into the file everyone reads) for an unsolved one (make everyone read a new file).

p.A-SIDECAR-IS-RIGHT-FOR-LARGE-PAYLOADS-AS: A sidecar *is* the right answer for large payloads — but as a complement to the block, not a replacement.

p.adoption-guide-pointer: See [`adoption-guide.xml`](adoption-guide.xml#what-belongs) on keeping the block small and pointing it at tool-owned files.

p.MODEL-DETECTION-DESIGN-FIND-THE-BLOCK-BY: *The design.* Instead of exact markers, find the block by intelligence: "locate the region that looks like the tool's output," possibly by asking an LLM, possibly by a fuzzy match against the last thing written.

p.model-detection-why-the-region-gates-a-m: *Why it is rejected.* The region gates a **mutating write** to a file full of someone else's data.

p.THE-GATE-ON-A-DESTRUCTIVE-OPERATION-MUST: The gate on a destructive operation must be **deterministic** — the same input yields the same region, every run, on every machine, forever.

p.a-model-is-nondeterministic-by-construct: A model or a heuristic is nondeterministic by construction: it returns "probably here," and a "probably" that is wrong once has overwritten content that does not belong to the tool.

p.no-acceptable-false-positive-rate-for-wh: There is no acceptable false-positive rate for "which bytes may I destroy."

p.A-BYTE-SCAN-IS-THE-ONLY-CORRECT-DESIGN: A plain line-anchored byte scan for a unique marker is not a lesser version of smart detection; it is the only correct design, because it is the only one whose answer you can prove before you write.

p.DETERMINISM-IS-THE-SAFETY-PROPERTY: Determinism is not a performance choice here — it is the safety property.

p.AUTO-REPAIR-DESIGN-THE-FILE-IS-MALFORMED: *The design.* The file has two opening markers, or an opener with no closer.

p.AUTO-REPAIR-DESIGN-BE-HELPFUL-AND-PROCEE: Be helpful: delete the surplus marker, keep the first block, and proceed.

p.A-MALFORMED-BLOCK-IS-EVIDENCE: *Why it is rejected.* A malformed block is **evidence** — of a failed previous write, a bad merge, a hand-edit that went wrong, or two tool versions disagreeing.

p.auto-repair-destroys-evidence-and-guesse: Auto-repair destroys that evidence before a human can read it, and the "repair" is a guess about which of two regions is canonical.

p.auto-repair-guess-wrong-and-you-delete-t: Guess wrong and you have deleted the block the user actually wanted and kept the stale one — silently, in the name of being helpful.

p.the-tool-has-no-basis-for-the-guess: The tool has no basis for the guess: nothing in the file says which duplicate is intended.

p.user-content-may-have-drifted-between-th: Worse, user content may have drifted *between* the stray markers, so deleting a marker can delete the user's own lines with it.

p.A-MALFORMED-BLOCK-IS-WHERE-THE-TOOL-MUST: A malformed block is exactly the case where the tool must stop and defer to the one party who knows what was meant.

p.HARD-STOP-PRECISE-REPORT-HUMAN-DECIDES: Hard stop, precise report, human decides (§drill).

p.WHOLE-FILE-DESIGN-THE-TOOL-OWNS-THE-WHOL: *The design.* Skip blocks entirely: the tool owns the whole file and regenerates it on every run.

p.WHOLE-FILE-REGENERATION-IS-ACCEPTABLE-ON: *Why it is mostly rejected — and the narrow case where it is fine.* Whole-file regeneration is acceptable **only** when the file is 100% tool-owned and marked as such — a generated `.lock` file, a `tool-cache.json`, a file whose first line says "generated file — do not edit, your changes will be lost."

p.in-that-case-there-is-no-co-tenant-to-pr: In that case there is no co-tenant, so there is nothing to protect.

p.OWNERSHIP-IS-NOT-A-DECISION-THE-TOOL-GET: The trap is that ownership is not a decision the tool gets to keep.

p.a-human-edit-makes-you-a-co-tenant: The moment a human edits the file — and they will, if it is readable and sits somewhere they look — you have a co-tenant, and whole-file regeneration silently deletes their edit on the next run.

p.THE-TEST-IS-CAN-ANYONE-ELSE-PLAUSIBLY-WR: So the test is not "did I intend to own this file" but "can anyone else plausibly write here."

p.IF-YES-YOU-OWN-A-BLOCK-NOT-THE-FILE: If yes, you are a co-tenant and you own a block, not the file.

p.RESERVE-WHOLE-FILE-OWNERSHIP-AND-MARK-IT: Reserve whole-file ownership for files that are unmistakably, permanently machine-only, and mark them loudly so no human mistakes them for editable.

drill.title: The malformed-state drill

p.ON-MALFORMED-THE-TOOL-ABORTS-AND-PRINTS-: When classification (see [`MANAGED-BLOCKS-PROTOCOL.xml`](MANAGED-BLOCKS-PROTOCOL.xml#state-machine)) returns *malformed*, the tool aborts the whole operation and prints a report with three parts.

td.ROW-REPORT-WHAT-I-FOUND-CONTENT: The file path and the exact defect, with line numbers: "two `<toolname>` opening markers, at lines 12 and 40."

td.ROW-REPORT-WHAT-I-EXPECTED-CONTENT: The well-formed shape: "either zero markers, or exactly one `<toolname>` … `</toolname>` pair in order."

td.ROW-REPORT-HOW-TO-UNBLOCK-CONTENT: The precise human action: "keep the block you want, delete the other opening marker and its closing marker, then re-run."

drill.fence:
error: managed block in CLAUDE.md is malformed — aborting, nothing written.
found: two opening markers <toolname> at lines 12 and 40 (expected exactly one) expected: zero markers, or one <toolname> … </toolname> pair in order fix: decide which block is canonical, delete the other opener and its matching closer, then re-run `toolname install`
No files were changed.

p.THREE-PROPERTIES-MAKE-THIS-DRILL-CORRECT: Three properties make this drill correct:

facts.DRILL-IT-CHANGES-NOTHING: **It changes nothing.** The file is left exactly as found, so the human debugs the real state, not a half-repaired one.
facts.DRILL-IT-IS-SPECIFIC: **It is specific.** Line numbers and the exact defect mean the human fixes it in seconds, without opening the tool's source.
facts.DRILL-IT-NAMES-THE-UNBLOCKING-ACTION: **It names the unblocking action.** The report ends by telling the human precisely what to do, so a hard stop is a thirty-second detour, not a support ticket.

facts.SUM-SIDECAR-FORFEITS-THE-HOST-FILES-ONE-: **Sidecar** — forfeits the one property that made the host file worth writing to: its consumer already reads it.
facts.SUM-MODEL-DETECTION-IS-A-NONDETERMINISTI: **Model / heuristic detection** — a nondeterministic gate on a destructive write; the region you may overwrite must be provable before you write.
facts.SUM-AUTO-REPAIR-DESTROYS-EVIDENCE-AND-GU: **Auto-repair** — destroys evidence and guesses which region is canonical; may delete user content that drifted between markers.
facts.SUM-WHOLE-FILE-OWNERSHIP-IS-FOR-MACHINE-: **Whole-file ownership** — fine only for permanently machine-only files, marked loudly; the moment a human edits it, you are a co-tenant and owe them a block.
facts.SUM-MALFORMED-GOES-TO-THE-DRILL: **Malformed → the drill**: change nothing, report what was found vs expected, name the exact human action that unblocks.
